name: every page, newest first
carries on from the page it stopped at, waiting out a busy Last.fm
busy six times is given up, the pages before it kept
a reconnect stops at once
tops up with what is newer, from two weeks below the newest
a top-up of more than a page
a top-up that finds nothing
another user starts over, beside the first
nothing scrobbled yet: done, and the whole history read again later
a resumed run whose bound is old tops up straight after
Spotify plays cover some, and lend their lengths
an empty page before the last is not the end
a page busy every time stops there, and the next run carries on from it
an empty page saying there are fewer pages is asked again, and a stumble passes
a history that really shrank is believed once asked enough
two accounts: each counts its own
another account’s rows taken over by Spotify leave this account’s count alone
a late scrobble, stamped below the newest kept, comes in with the next top-up, once
the overlap counts what Spotify covers once, not again on every top-up
a top-up cut short counts what Spotify covers once, when the window is all in
a top-up cut short keeps its count but not its window
the count is the archive’s: rows written before the app closed count on the next run
lengths at write time, from Spotify and the library
